provenance_quote: The gene encoding the secreted 53-kDa metalloprotease (protease B) and the 5' end of the gene encoding the secreted 55-kDa metalloprotease (protease C) of the Gram-negative bacterium Erwinia chrysanthemi have been sequenced. The predicted sequences of the two proteases do not have typical signal sequences at their NH2 termini
notes: DOI 10.1016/S0021-9258(18)81905-6 = PMID 2722818 (Delepelaire & Wandersman 1989, JBC). Abstract confirms secreted metalloprotease B lacking signal peptide, secreted into external medium = signal-peptide-independent (T1SS). Citation quote verified verbatim against PubMed abstract. UniProt P16316 live: Serralysin B/Secreted protease B, GN=prtB, OS=Dickeya chrysanthemi. According to PubMed.

provenance_quote: LipA, HasA, and E. chrysanthemi PrtC were secreted via heterologous exporters and via some hybrid exporters.
notes: DOI 10.1128/jb.179.15.4754-4760.1997 = PMID 9244262 / PMC179321 (Akatsuka et al. 1997, J Bacteriol). Abstract describes secretion via three-component ABC exporters (N-terminal signal-peptide-independent = T1SS); citation quote verified verbatim in PMC abstract. UniProt P16317 live: Serralysin C/Secreted protease C, GN=prtC, OS=Dickeya chrysanthemi. According to PubMed.

provenance_quote: Using mariner mutagenesis and a screen for loss of cytotoxicity, a genetic locus encoding an RTX toxin system was identified.
notes: DOI 10.1128/JB.01319-06 = PMID 17098895 / PMC1797395 (Kehl-Fie & St. Geme 2007, J Bacteriol). Abstract confirms RTX toxin locus in Kingella kingae; citation quote verified verbatim in PMC abstract. RTX toxins are canonical T1SS substrates. UniProt A1YKW7 live: Cytolysin RtxA / Repeats in toxin A, GN=rtxA, OS=Kingella kingae, keyword secreted toxin/virulence factor. According to PubMed.
